verdict.rationale: Stripe Radar exposes documented REST API endpoints (e.g. reviews, early_fraud_warnings, value_lists) and is part of Stripe's broader public API with an official CLI and MCP server, confirming programmatic/agentic access. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec file was found (probe 404s) and no independent hands-on report of an AI agent driving Radar specifically via the API.
